correctness.rationale: For all p>=7 the Jacobian/Vandermonde rank obstruction plus 5 s2-s1^2=m(5-m)(a-b)^2 excludes singular points; the classical smooth degree-six genus-four facts also appear in arXiv:2112.10886. At p=2 and p=3 the exact Frobenius identities s2=s1^2 and s3=s1^3 respectively produce smooth surfaces by a two-row rank test. At p=5 an invertible coordinate change makes the ideal (sum y_i,sum y_i^2,sum y_i^3) independent of one vertex coordinate; eliminating gives a transverse conic Q and three-line cubic C with six reduced F5 direction points, hence exactly six lines meeting once. Hilbert series 1+3t+5t^2+6t^3+... and normalization 6-dimensional in every degree give delta=9. Six rational lines give 6*5^r+1 over every F_(5^r) and the stated zeta function. The embedded finite-field verifier reproduces source equations and selected enumerations, but the universal statements are proved symbolically. Newton identity signs and projective conditions have been checked.

originality.rationale: The precise six-line reduced complete-intersection fiber at p=5, its unique delta-nine singularity, all-extension zeta formula and p=2,3 surface dimension jumps were not found in the two directly relevant full texts or targeted mathematical-record searches. Characteristic >=7 smoothness and the fixed canonical equations are prior work. Crucially, arXiv:2112.10886 sec.11.1 cites Redei for F5-rational permutation tuples of the DIFFERENT p=5 system with only s1,s2, so it covers the permutation directions and implies the r=1 point count of this fiber, but not the degree-three scheme cut, its geometric decomposition, normalization invariant, or r>=2 counts. This distinction is recorded rather than claiming all pieces new. Characteristic-zero tritangent and Weierstrass results have different objects and do not imply these modular scheme claims.

value.rationale: For the natural distinguished S5-symmetric canonical Bring model, this supplies a complete exact description of all exceptional characteristic fibers, explains two sharp dimension changes, and connects a reduced six-line degeneration with a six-branch local delta-nine singularity and an all-extension finite-field zeta function. This is a natural geometric/arithmetic boundary classification, not arbitrary slice or numerical sample; the genus four arithmetic genus is shown to persist despite extreme reducibility.
